responses.title: Birding in Pacific | AVES Colombia
responses.description: Rainforest, broad rivers and humid foothills on Colombia’s Pacific side. Explore forest birds of the Chocó and the lower western slopes of the Andes.

responses.title: Birding in Western Andes | AVES Colombia
responses.ogTitle: Birding in Western Andes | AVES Colombia
responses.twitterTitle: Birding in Western Andes | AVES Colombia
responses.description: Cloud forest and wooded ridges along the Western Cordillera, with especially wet forests on its Pacific-facing slopes.

responses.title: Birding in Central Andes | AVES Colombia
responses.ogTitle: Birding in Central Andes | AVES Colombia
responses.twitterTitle: Birding in Central Andes | AVES Colombia
responses.description: Colombia’s central mountain chain connects cloud forest and coffee-country slopes with cold páramo around its higher peaks.

responses.title: Birding in Eastern Andes | AVES Colombia
responses.ogTitle: Birding in Eastern Andes | AVES Colombia
responses.twitterTitle: Birding in Eastern Andes | AVES Colombia
responses.description: The Eastern Cordillera spans high páramo, humid mountain forest and wooded foothills, with distinct habitats at each elevation.

responses.title: Birding in Cauca Valley | AVES Colombia
responses.ogTitle: Birding in Cauca Valley | AVES Colombia
responses.twitterTitle: Birding in Cauca Valley | AVES Colombia
responses.description: Dry-forest remnants and open river-country landscapes lie between the Western and Central Andes, with wetter bird habitats on the wooded foothills.

responses.title: Birding in Magdalena Valley | AVES Colombia
responses.ogTitle: Birding in Magdalena Valley | AVES Colombia
responses.twitterTitle: Birding in Magdalena Valley | AVES Colombia
responses.description: A long inter-Andean river corridor, with dry woodland in some sectors and humid forest mosaics in others. Plan around the habitat, not just the valley name.

responses.title: Caribbean Region - Coastal & Foothill Birding Tours | AVES
responses.ogTitle: Caribbean Region - Coastal & Foothill Birding Tours | AVES
responses.twitterTitle: Caribbean Region - Coastal & Foothill Birding Tours | AVES
responses.description: Discover coastal & Sierra Nevada foothills birding in Colombia. Explore Riohacha, Las Gaviotas, mangroves & dry forest with expert guides.

responses.title: Birding in Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta | AVES Colombia
responses.ogTitle: Birding in Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta | AVES Colombia
responses.twitterTitle: Birding in Sierra Nevada de Santa Marta | AVES Colombia
responses.description: An isolated mountain range above the Caribbean, with forest birds found nowhere else. Its endemic species are distinct from those of the Andean cordilleras.

responses.title: Birding in Llanos | AVES Colombia
responses.description: Eastern savannas change with the water: flooded grasslands, river margins and gallery forests each support different bird communities.

responses.title: Birding in Amazonia | AVES Colombia
responses.description: Lowland rainforest, flooded forest and river-edge vegetation in Colombia’s Amazon basin. A forest trail and a quiet waterside route reveal very different birds.

responses.title: Birding in Colombian Massif | AVES Colombia
responses.ogTitle: Birding in Colombian Massif | AVES Colombia
responses.twitterTitle: Birding in Colombian Massif | AVES Colombia
responses.description: Southern Andean headwaters, mountain forest and páramo around the meeting of Colombia’s major ranges, including the Puracé landscape.

responses.twitterTitle: Birding in Tasmania | Hobart & Bruny Island | AVES Australia

responses.twitterTitle: Birding in Victoria | Melbourne & Serendip Sanctuary | AVES Australia

responses.ogTitle: Birding in Western Australia | Perth & Yanchep woodland
responses.twitterTitle: Birding in Western Australia | Perth & Yanchep woodland | AVES Australia
responses.description: Start with Perth’s northern wetlands and Yanchep’s woodland, where western parrots and fairywrens give familiar habitats a different character.

responses.ogTitle: Birding in Northern Territory | Darwin, Fogg Dam & Kakadu
responses.twitterTitle: Birding in Northern Territory | Darwin, Fogg Dam & Kakadu | AVES Australia
